VTS Scoring Log

Polaris Peptides

polarispeptides.com · Est. ~2024 · Polaris Bioactives LLC · Scored August 2026

Polaris Peptides operates a members-only site: products, COAs, test results, and all policy pages - including the refund and return policy - redirect unauthenticated visitors to a login and registration form. No testing lab is named in any publicly accessible content. Third-party reviews confirm HPLC and mass spectrometry testing is claimed and that COAs are available on request via customer support, but they are not published on product pages. The operating entity Polaris Bioactives LLC and a customer service phone number (+1 800-273-9462) are visible in the footer of the login wall - the only meaningful public disclosures at time of scoring. The site also operates under a secondary domain (polarispeptidesusa.com) with no public explanation of the relationship between the two.

21 /100

Community Signal
Independent Test Results
Finnrick tracks a moderate number of Polaris Peptides samples, including tirzepatide data showing an 8.8/10 average across 15 samples with a floor of 6.5. Retatrutide and semaglutide show wider batch variance (3.9-9.0 and 4.7-8.7 ranges respectively). These are Finnrick ratings, not raw purity percentages; the variance pattern suggests batch-to-batch consistency issues on certain SKUs. Community Signal data, not a VTS scoring input.
Community Experience
Third-party reviews cite shipping speed and product quality as positives. At least one documented customer support interaction involved a COA request that went unanswered for an extended period before being resolved. The members-only model limits the volume of pre-purchase community discussion in open forums.
Scoring Notes
The members-only model extends to policy pages
Most login-gated vendors in this catalog keep their policy pages (refund, shipping, terms) publicly accessible even when products require an account. Polaris Peptides gates everything - a researcher cannot review refund terms, shipping policy, or return conditions before creating an account. This is a more restrictive posture than Skye Peptides (which also gates products and COAs, but publishes a physical address without login) and is reflected in the policy transparency score.
COA on request vs. COA on product page
Even among vendors without a public COA library, the standard minimum is publishing COAs on individual product pages or maintaining a downloadable archive. Polaris routes COA requests through customer support, meaning a researcher cannot see any documentation before purchase without creating an account and making a support request. This is the most restrictive COA access model in the catalog short of a full login gate, which is also present here.
Sources: polarispeptides.com login wall (entity name, phone number, and footer links visible without login), third-party review documentation, Finnrick testing dataset. All product, COA, and policy content redirected to login page at time of scoring. VTS measures process transparency from publicly available materials only. It is not a certification of product safety, purity, or efficacy. PeptideClear has no affiliate, referral, or commercial relationship with Polaris Peptides. Scored August 2026 - reviewed on a rolling basis as vendor practices change.
